name: Mortal Realm
description: The sunlit main landscape of Theros where living mortals dwell, and the only Therosian realm directly enterable by planeswalking.

timeline.summary: The Returned escape the underworld via the Path of Phenax, losing their identities, and gather in the necropoleis.
timeline.quote: The necropoleis of Asphodel and Odunos house the Returned, undead beings who have escaped the underworld at the cost of their identities.

timeline.summary: Heliod has died, leaving it unclear whether his solstice holiday is still celebrated.
timeline.quote: whether this holiday is still celebrated after Heliod's death is unknown.
